title: Dunkin billboard
observation: Short question, large product pack and visible product branding; no body paragraph.
caution: Copy the hierarchy principle, not its pink palette or flat campaign treatment. No evidence here of measured campaign uplift.

title: Chiquita billboard
observation: Four-word message arranged around a dominant banana; brand cue separate.
caution: A long feature list would compete with this simple silhouette. The seven-word benchmark is not a mandatory ceiling.

title: LinkedIn FixDex and Flexis guide examples
observation: Longer explanation and action are in native UI around an image.
caution: The illustration contains an older event date; use it for native/image separation, not current interface geometry.

title: Mailchimp product crop example
observation: Product details fill tightly cropped image blocks; names and prices occupy separate lines below.
caution: Tiny screenshot prices are not evidence of accessible type. Keep the surrounding email text live and test the actual column width.

title: Vista event flyer by Rose
observation: Large opening headline, event identity, emphasized date and grouped venue/sponsors.
caution: Small address and thin script are weaker at small display size. Strong hierarchy alone cannot prove A6 print readability.

title: Vista Panelfox handout
observation: Headline followed by separated short feature groups and contact area.
caution: Perspective mockup conceals actual printed point size. Use grouping, then verify flat art at real dimensions.

title: Pinterest Balanced Table furniture example
observation: Furniture and decor are visually dominant; small brand cue in the image, headline in native text below.
caution: Useful product-to-scene balance; its styling is not Duroflex or Sleepyhead brand guidance.

title: Google responsive image overlay examples
observation: Plain food image is contrasted with competing headline/menu overlays.
caution: This is an explanatory diagram for responsive image assets, not a blanket text prohibition for uploaded ads.

title: Android big picture notification
observation: Same photo is tiny when collapsed and large when expanded; native title carries the meaning.
caution: A branded poster inserted into the attachment would become unreadable in the collapsed preview.
